title: 咏鹅
author: Luo Binwang

translation: Bend their necks and sing to the sky
White feathers float on green water
Red feet paddle through clear waves

annotations.曲项: bend the neck — describing the goose's posture

appreciation: Written by Luo Binwang at age seven, this is often the first poem Chinese children learn. In just four lines it paints a vivid picture: white feathers, green water, red webbed feet, clear waves. The repetition of 'goose, goose, goose' mimics a child's delighted cry upon seeing the birds.
